title: 信息日报 2026-08-30

headline.title: OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌等百余家公司呼吁共同防御恶意AI
headline.summary: 世界上一些最大的科技公司和人工智能初创公司联合起来，谴责当前网络安全状况，并宣传一种他们声称可以抵御新一代网络威胁的新解决方案。
headline.title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and 100 other companies call for action to defend against rogue AI
headline.summary_en: Some of the world's largest tech companies and AI startups have come together to decry the current state of cybersecurity and advertise a new solution that they say can ward off a new generation of cyber threats.
headline.original_title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and 100 other companies call for action to defend against rogue AI
headline.reason: AI安全成为当天最受关注的议题，多家科技巨头联合发声，反映出产业对AI失控风险的高度警惕，是理解未来监管与投资动向的关键新闻。
headline.reason_en: AI safety emerged as the day's top issue, with major tech companies joining forces, highlighting the industry's high alert over rogue AI risks and serving as a key signal for future regulation and investment.
